name: Nameless Venom
description: Sink a venom with no name into the foe's guard arm and let it find the heart.

name: Nameless Cloud
description: Breathe a cloud of nameless venom across the front that no test can identify.

name: Nameless Thread
description: Spin a thread of nameless venom round the foe that tightens whenever it is named.

name: Nameless Remedy
description: Draw even an unknown poison from an ally's blood by feeling its shape alone.

name: Nameless Mantle
description: Wear a mantle that drinks any poison and any blow without learning their names.

name: Nameless Venomedge
description: Draw an edge of nameless venom across the foe that no hide or ward can stop.

name: Nameless Step
description: Step through the foe's line on a thread of nameless mist and appear behind them.

name: Nameless Scent
description: Scent every poison on the field, named or nameless, and mark who carries it.

name: Nameless Crown
description: Set a crown of nameless venom on the foe that pierces and holds them still.

name: Nameless Pall
description: Lower a pall of nameless venom over a field that slows and sickens all beneath it.

name: Nameless Calamity
description: Loose a nameless calamity at the ceiling of the core tier, poisoning an entire field beyond cure.

name: Incurable Bane
description: Make the dose incurable: no remedy, qi or soul craft can undo it afterward, a thing no energy mechanic explains.
